rows.summary: A search key no longer folds every job's six fields again (each job's folded search text is kept per job object and re-folded only when a field changes; plain ASCII skips the accent strip) and no longer re-renders every card (KanbanCard and DraggableCard are memoised behind stable handlers, drag-sensor options are constants, the filtered list is memoised). Matches and their order are unchanged. Proved by counts for 3000 jobs: a second key makes 0 normalize calls, and a search that keeps 100 cards re-renders 0 cards. A new day is passed to every card as a prop, so the memoised cards draw again past midnight and a deadline pill never keeps yesterday's state (test in 118, failfirst 0061e899 green).
rows.remaining: Not measured in a browser: the work counts are the proof, the 696 ms figure was not re-measured. The first key still folds each non-ASCII job once.

rows.summary: Measured once on CI in Chromium on the production bundle (run 37401585716, long-task observer, 5.7 MB plain-text paste, throwaway spec, since deleted): resume summary 1880 ms (one long task), job notes 604 ms, ATS box 153 ms (already capped), resume bullet not reachable by the spec (same RichTextEditor as the summary). The stall was the rich-text paste itself. PRODUCT CALL: one paste into a rich-text field now takes in at most 200,000 characters, inserted as plain text (a huge HTML page goes in as its plain-text part), with the line 'The pasted text was cut to its first 200,000 characters.' under the field; ordinary pastes are unchanged. Re-measured after the fix (run 37401887625): summary 188 ms, job notes 120 ms, ATS box 175 ms. The ATS job-description box has the same limit (200,000, maxLength, line shown while full, older stored postings scanned only to it), and its keyword scan composes the posting once.
rows.remaining: The hunt's 6.8 s figure was on its own machine; CI's slower-than-1-s number was 1.9 s. Resume bullet editor was not exercised separately.

rows.summary: Measured in node, no stall: jobsFromText and mergeImport on up to 40,000 jobs (8 MB) take 0.29 s at most and are linear; jobsToCsv on 40,000 jobs 0.26 s; one job with a 5.7 MB note parses in 6 ms and merges in 56 ms (its CSV export is 0.75 s).

issues: Posting cap: a posting restored from the session was never capped and showed no notice.
Posting cap: the notice was local state set only in onChange, so it went stale on a résumé switch or remount.
Posting cap: a paste into a non-empty box cut the whole new value, dropping the end of the existing text.
KanbanCard memoisation freezes the DatePill's overdue/today state until the job object changes (minor: stale past midnight).
The first CI run showed useDeferredValue breaks two existing synchronous tests (R2-156 search, R4-DUX-18), so it was dropped.
fixedByReviewer: Stored long posting scanned only to the limit, the notice derived from the box's length, and maxLength on the box instead of an onChange cut (d6ff8e98).
